judgment_text:
PETITION filed under Article 226 of The Constitution of India praying for issuance of a WRIT OF HABEAS CORPUS or any other appropriate writ, order or direction in the nature of writ calling for the records in detention order passed in memo No. 7/2025 dated on 3-9-2025 on the file of the 2nd respondent herein and quash the same and direct the respondents herein to produce the person or body of my son THIRU. VINOTH KUMAR AGED 36 YEARS, S/O. Datchinamoorthy confined in Central Prison Puzhal, Chennai district before this Honble Court and set him at liberty.

The Order of the Court was delivered by

Dr Anita Sumanth, J.:— Nothing survives in this HCP as the period of detention under the Prevention of Black Marketing and Maintenance of Supplies of Essential Commodities Act, 1980 has already been completed.

2. Recording the aforesaid, this HCP is closed.
